The shop

Mexico, the States, Canada — and the Hunab Ku

Four marks sit stacked beside the name on their own logo: the flag of Mexico, the flag of the United States, the flag of Canada, and a Mayan Hunab Ku disc.

That stack is the shortest description of the room anyone could write. Google lists the shop as LGBTQ+ friendly. Reviewers mention Spanish-speaking artists. The door on Pacific Ave takes walk-ins the same day, and the front window has kept its OPEN sign lit every day of the week.

Five artists get named by name in the reviews and on their own materials — which is usually the sign of a shop where you get a person, not a slot.

Getting in

Three steps and you're in the chair

  1. Say what you want

    A reference photo, a screenshot, or a rough idea — they draw it up in the shop.

  2. Text or DM

    The shop's line is a mobile, so a text gets there. Instagram DMs get read too.

  3. Come by

    Ask for the artist whose work you liked, or take whoever's free.
